The season began on 21 February 2026 and will end in November 2026.{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://lietuvosfutbolas.lt/varzybos/vyru/a-lyga/|website=lietuvosfutbolas.lt|title=A Lyga - Lietuvos Futbolas|language=lt}}{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.alyga.lt/naujiena/2026-metu-a-lygos-klubu-tarpsezonio-sudetys/9277|website=alyga.lt|title=2026 metų A lygos klubų tarpsezonio sudėtys|language=lt}} This was first season renamed from '''A Lyga'''. ==Teams== The league consisted of ten teams; the top nine teams from the previous season, and one team promoted from the [[LFF I Lyga]]. [[FK Kauno Žalgiris|Kauno Žalgiris]] entered the season as defending champions. The promoted team was the [[2025 LFF I Lyga]] champions [[FK TransINVEST|TransINVEST]] (returning to the TOPLYGA after a single-season absence). They replaced the [[2025 A Lyga]] bottom-placed team [[DFK Dainava|Dainava]] (relegated from the TOPLYGA after three seasons).{{#invoke:cite|web|title=TransINVEST secures I Lyga title and seals top-flight return |url=https://balticfootballnews.com/transinvest-secures-pirma-lyga-title-and-seals-top-flight-return/ |website=Baltic Football News |access-date=13 January 2026}} {{Location map+ |Lithuania |width=400 |float=right |caption=Locations of the 2026 TOPLYGA teams|places= {{Location map~ |Lithuania |lat=55.9848 |long=22.2426 |label='''[[FC Džiugas Telšiai|Džiugas]]''' |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Lithuania |lat=55.9368 |long=23.2954 |label='''[[FA Šiauliai]]''' |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Lithuania |lat=55.7392 |long=24.3595 |label='''[[FK Panevėžys|Panevėžys]]''' |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Lithuania |lat=55.7155 |long=21.4043 |label='''[[FK Banga Gargždai|Banga]]''' |position=right}} {{location map~ |Lithuania |lat=54.9149 |long=23.7727 |label='''[[FC Hegelmann|Hegelmann]]''' |position=top|link=FC Hegelmann}} {{location map~ |Lithuania |lat=54.8974 |long=23.9374 |label='''{{nowrap|[[FK Kauno Žalgiris|Kauno Žalgiris]]}}''' |position=bottom|link=FK Kauno Žalgiris}} {{location map~ |Lithuania |lat=54.6682 |long=25.2952 |label='''[[FK Žalgiris|Žalgiris]]
